name: glTF skins and clips into rigs
body: Replaces the importer's 'not started' status on import-skins-and-animations-from-gltf: this card builds it. Read a glTF skin (joints, JOINTS_0, WEIGHTS_0) into a Skeleton and a skinned MeshData, and its animations (translation, rotation; linear and step) into AnimationClips, as a Rig.
plan: 1. GltfRig.nox in renderer: LoadGltfRig(path, options) and GltfRigFromBytes. Joints are ordered parents first and capped at MAX_JOINTS. Options: scale, yaw, feet on the ground. 2. Clips resample onto the union of each joint's key times. Cubic spline keeps its values and drops tangents. Scale tracks are ignored (clips do not animate scale). 3. Nyx: lantern::animation::LoadRig(path, scale, yawDegrees). 4. Test with a hand-built skinned glb.
acceptance_criteria: A skinned glb loads as a rig with its joints, clips and weights
A file with more than 32 joints fails with a clear message
Rest pose skinning is the identity
definition_of_done: Tests added and `mist run test` passes
